detailed_description: DrDroid is an AI-powered assistant designed to support on-call engineers by accelerating production issue diagnosis and improving response times. It integrates with popular observability, CI/CD, and incident management tools such as Datadog, Grafana, Kubernetes, ArgoCD, New Relic, and GitHub. It automates the grunt work of digging through logs, correlating metrics, and suggesting remediation actions, allowing engineers to focus on high-impact decisions and faster fixes. It also enhances team collaboration by integrating with communication platforms like Slack and Microsoft Teams, auto-generating incident summaries, and dynamically updating incident statuses to keep all stakeholders informed.
